verdict.rationale: Docs and community evidence confirm E2B sandboxes execute code via runCode() in at least Python and JavaScript (e2b-docs-1, e2b-comm-1), with supporting filesystem/command APIs, but the evidence pack never shows the 'rich results' output (e.g., images, charts, dataframes) that E2B is often known for, nor explicit support for many additional languages beyond Python/JS. Missing for 10: evidence of rich, multi-format execution results (images/charts/HTML), and explicit documentation of additional runtimes beyond Python/JS.
